description: Florida beach water health advisories right now: beaches where the county health department found bacteria (enterococcus) over the state limit and has not posted a lift yet, from all 32 coastal counties' own posts (Miami-Dade, Broward, Palm Beach, Tampa Bay, Naples, the Panhandle...). Closest first within a radius when you give a position, or match a beach or county name; with neither, every open advisory in the state. Gives one sentence to say out loud and the health department's link. No advisory is not the same as a clean test, and the result says so; it never calls the water clean or safe.

lat.description: Latitude of where the person is or will be

miles.description: Radius around lat/lon in miles (default 15, max 100)

place.description: Or part of a beach name or a county, e.g. Crandon, Davis Island, Miami-Dade

name: beach_water
title: Beach water advisories
